_doc: Reproducible crop rectangles for the Interchange Intro Unit 1 scans.
Pixels in the page as rendered by:  pdftoppm -png -r 140
At 140 dpi every page of this scan is 1157 x 1637.
'page' is the 1-based page of 'Interchange Intro - Unit 01.pdf'; 'book' is
'avoid' are the pirate watermarks. crop.mjs refuses to emit a rectangle
that overlaps one, so a bad rectangle fails the build instead of shipping
a watermark into the student's worksheet.
'patch' rectangles are painted out with the median colour of the ring of
pixels around them BEFORE cropping. Used only where a watermark sits on
top of artwork the exercise needs - Ex 7 picture 4 has the Persian stamp
printed across the middle of the photograph, and cropping around it would
cut the speech bubble the exercise is about.
Unlike the tile crops in ~/bridge, these keep the speech bubbles: here the
printed dialogue IS the exercise ('Listen and practice'), not the answer.
